sources.source_name: Public Design Commission past meeting minutes archive
sources.publisher: New York City Public Design Commission
sources.license: No explicit data license was found on archived PDFs during this worker pass; treat as official NYC.gov public records subject to NYC.gov terms.
sources.geographic_scope: Mostly New York City public buildings, parks, streets, plazas, waterfronts, civic facilities, cultural facilities, public art, and infrastructure requiring PDC review.
sources.granularity: Meeting PDF and certificate-level design-review action.
required_caveats: The archive is PDF-first and OCR/text extraction can introduce typos in street numbers or exhibit labels.
Some older records use the former Art Commission name.
Approval conditions often require later final review or later commencement, so dates must be labelled as approval/adoption dates only.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Use as a high-quality official source for design-review milestones, with manual QA for extracted text and geometry.

sources.source_name: NYC Public Design Commission meeting minutes and certificates, 2008-2026 PDFs
sources.publisher: New York City Public Design Commission
sources.license: Official NYC.gov public records; explicit open-data redistribution license not verified for the PDF collection.
sources.update_frequency: Meeting-driven; newest certificates may be revised after posting.
sources.geographic_scope: NYC public design review records, with a small number of city-agency facilities outside NYC that should be excluded from NYC city-atlas events.
sources.granularity: Certificate-level action within each meeting/minutes PDF.
required_caveats: Use the adoption date as the design-review milestone date, not as a construction date.
Use approval type exactly enough to distinguish preliminary, final, amended final, conceptual, and preliminary-and-final actions.
Treat manual point coordinates as approximate until replaced by verified address/intersection or GIS geometry.
Do not infer causation, public benefit, project completion, opening date, or outcome from PDC approval.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Recommended for a NYC design-review milestone layer after a second pass validates geocoding and removes duplicate preliminary/final records for the same project when necessary.
